title: Stationary MCH Ising fits (July 2026, all reaches)
question: How well does a stationary pairwise Ising model fit PC population activity per block?
headline: Ising reproduces P(K) (wins 62/63 blocks); |J| beats 100 rate-preserving shuffles in 63/63. Superseded as primary fits by E08 (exclusions applied).
